text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived in the blink of an eye, bringing January.
Starting this year, Ines Fujin will be taking on the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh, is Fu's Trainer working through a meal on New Year's again?
choice_data_list: Yes, because I'm in the Senior Class starting this year!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. This back-and-forth brings back memories. How about I throw in a soft-boiled egg on the house, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year,
everyo~ne.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The left lane is currently open, so please go ahead and use that one—!
choice_data_list: Working crowd control again this year?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Happy New Year to you too, Trainer~!
Well, better safe than sorry, right!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Since things are tough for Mom right now, I definitely want to keep sending money home."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I've been holding back more than I used to, though.
For my little sisters' sake, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As always, Ines Fujin continues her daily routine
of juggling part-time jobs and racing
for the sake of her little sisters and family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet ever since that incident at the Arima Kinen,
Ines Fujin looked as though a weight had been lifted from her shoulders,
running with a natural grace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as pushing the body too hard affects the mind,
easing the burden on her heart seems to have had
a synergistic effect on her running as well.
choice_data_list: Looks like there's nothing to worry about.
Looks like there's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer.
Did you happen to make a request
to the ramen shop owner as well?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly said she's giving me a raise.
Saying, "I want to repay at least a little bit of the kindness
you've shown me, Fuu"...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I heard from the manager,
have you really been eating ramen right at the start of the new year, both last year and this year?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!? Ramen right at the start of the new year?
Is your diet going to be balanced like that!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Take care of your health, okay?
Make sure you use the comprehensive medical checkups provided by the academy!
No matter how busy work gets!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, very well~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's just get in line.
Since you came here too, Trainer,
you're here for Hatsumode to pray, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"The third row on the left moves right away now!
Look, see?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sent off by Ines Fuujin, I joined the line to pray at the shrine. While waiting, I thought about what wish to make this year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I put my hands together and prayed for her health in the days ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Braving the bitter winter chill on my skin,
I suddenly thought of Ines Fujin, who was even now
hard at work organizing the lines—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Refreshments?
choice_data_list: Sorry all I have is tea, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehh! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...It's really warm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She must have been feeling the cold after all.
Ines Fujin was clutching the bag of
bottled tea tightly to her chest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
May we continue to have good races...
I clasp my hands and offer a prayer.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Family Member A
text_block_list.text: Hey, we're done praying, so let's draw fortune slips~!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Family Member B
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, you have exams coming up, right?
Dad's gonna buy you a good luck charm."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, a charm? Even for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "‘Wish Fulfillment’... By the way, did you buy the same one, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Yeah! Because I want to keep leading you to victory!
Yeah! Because I want to keep leading you to victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, then we match!
I'm totally putting mine on my bag!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin happily accepted
the protective charm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I prayed for a year where we could hone our skills together, so that we may keep seizing victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've come up with a new plan since New Year's.
I can't wait to share the new menu with Ines Fujin!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. Trainer.
Are you done making your prayer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then wanna walk home together?
I just finished my part-time shift too.
choice_data_list: Really!? That makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back, I also mentioned that I wanted to discuss this year's training plan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so serious~...
Way too stiff right from the New Year...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, but that's my Trainer for you.
Hehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ines Fujin and I discussed
the new training regimen
we'd start from the New Year.
